verses.original: כֹּה־ יְהוָה֮ אָמַ֣ר לְכ֣וֹרֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר־ לִמְשִׁיחוֹ֮ בִֽימִינ֗וֹ הֶחֱזַ֣קְתִּי לְרַד־ גּוֹיִ֔ם וּמָתְנֵ֥י לְפָנָיו֙ אֲפַתֵּ֑חַ מְלָכִ֖ים לִפְתֹּ֤חַ דְּלָתַ֔יִם לְפָנָיו֙ וּשְׁעָרִ֖ים לֹ֥א יִסָּגֵֽרוּ׃
verses.transliteration: kōh- Yah·weh ’ā·mar lə·ḵō·w·reš ’ă·šer- lim·šî·ḥōw ḇî·mî·nōw he·ḥĕ·zaq·tî lə·raḏ- gō·w·yim ū·mā·ṯə·nê lə·p̄ā·nāw ’ă·p̄at·tê·aḥ mə·lā·ḵîm lip̄·tō·aḥ də·lā·ṯa·yim lə·p̄ā·nāw ū·šə·‘ā·rîm lō yis·sā·ḡê·rū
verses.literal: This is what the LORD says to Cyrus - His anointed whose right hand I have grasped to subdue nations . . . before him to disarm kings to open the doors before him so that the gates will not be shut

verses.original: אֲנִי֙ אֵלֵ֔ךְ לְפָנֶ֣יךָ אוֹשִׁר וַהֲדוּרִ֖ים אֲשַׁבֵּ֔ר דַּלְת֤וֹת נְחוּשָׁה֙ אֲגַדֵּֽעַ׃ וּבְרִיחֵ֥י בַרְזֶ֖ל
verses.transliteration: ’ă·nî ’ê·lêḵ lə·p̄ā·ne·ḵā ʾō·šir wa·hă·ḏū·rîm ’ă·šab·bêr dal·ṯō·wṯ nə·ḥū·šāh ’ă·ḡad·dê·a‘ ū·ḇə·rî·ḥê ḇar·zel
verses.literal: I will go before you and level the mountains I will break down the gates of bronze and cut through the bars of iron

verses.original: וְנָתַתִּ֤י לְךָ֙ אוֹצְר֣וֹת חֹ֔שֶׁךְ וּמַטְמֻנֵ֖י מִסְתָּרִ֑ים לְמַ֣עַן תֵּדַ֗ע כִּֽי־ אֲנִ֧י יְהוָ֛ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ הַקּוֹרֵ֥א בְשִׁמְךָ֖
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·ṯat·tî lə·ḵā ’ō·wṣ·rō·wṯ ḥō·šeḵ ū·maṭ·mu·nê mis·tā·rîm lə·ma·‘an tê·ḏa‘ kî- ’ă·nî Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl haq·qō·w·rê ḇə·šim·ḵā
verses.literal: I will give you the treasures of darkness and the riches hidden in secret places so that you may know that I [am] the LORD the God of Israel who calls you by name

verses.original: לְמַ֙עַן֙ יַעֲקֹ֔ב עַבְדִּ֣י וְיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּחִירִ֑י וָאֶקְרָ֤א לְךָ֙ בִּשְׁמֶ֔ךָ אֲכַנְּךָ֖ וְלֹ֥א יְדַעְתָּֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: lə·ma·‘an ya·‘ă·qōḇ ‘aḇ·dî wə·yiś·rā·’êl bə·ḥî·rî wā·’eq·rā lə·ḵā biš·me·ḵā ’ă·ḵan·nə·ḵā wə·lō yə·ḏa‘·tā·nî
verses.literal: For the sake of Jacob My servant and Israel My chosen one I call you by name I have given you a title of honor though you have not known Me

verses.original: אֲנִ֤י יְהוָה֙ וְאֵ֣ין ע֔וֹד אֵ֣ין אֱלֹהִ֑ים זוּלָתִ֖י אֲאַזֶּרְךָ֖ וְלֹ֥א יְדַעְתָּֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·nî Yah·weh wə·’ên ‘ō·wḏ ’ên ’ĕ·lō·hîm zū·lā·ṯî ’ă·’az·zer·ḵā wə·lō yə·ḏa‘·tā·nî
verses.literal: I am the LORD and there is no other there is no God but Me I will equip you for battle though you have not known Me

verses.original: לְמַ֣עַן יֵדְע֗וּ מִמִּזְרַח־ שֶׁ֙מֶשׁ֙ וּמִמַּ֣עֲרָבָ֔הּ כִּי־ אֶ֖פֶס בִּלְעָדָ֑י אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה וְאֵ֥ין עֽוֹד׃
verses.transliteration: lə·ma·‘an yê·ḏə·‘ū mim·miz·raḥ- še·meš ū·mim·ma·‘ă·rā·ḇāh kî- ’e·p̄es bil·‘ā·ḏāy ’ă·nî Yah·weh wə·’ên ‘ō·wḏ
verses.literal: so that all may know from where the sun rises . . . to where it sets that there is none but Me I am the LORD and there is no other

verses.original: יוֹצֵ֥ר אוֹר֙ וּבוֹרֵ֣א חֹ֔שֶׁךְ עֹשֶׂ֥ה שָׁל֖וֹם וּב֣וֹרֵא רָ֑ע אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה עֹשֶׂ֥ה כָל־ אֵֽלֶּה׃ס
verses.transliteration: yō·w·ṣêr ’ō·wr ū·ḇō·w·rê ḥō·šeḵ ‘ō·śeh šā·lō·wm ū·ḇō·w·rê rā‘ ’ă·nî Yah·weh ‘ō·śeh ḵāl ’êl·leh
verses.literal: I form the light and create the darkness I bring prosperity and create calamity I the LORD do all these things

verses.original: הַרְעִ֤יפוּ שָׁמַ֙יִם֙ מִמַּ֔עַל וּשְׁחָקִ֖ים יִזְּלוּ־ צֶ֑דֶק אֶ֣רֶץ תִּפְתַּח־ יֶ֗שַׁע וְיִפְרוּ־ וּצְדָקָ֤ה תַצְמִ֙יחַ֙ יַ֔חַד אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה בְּרָאתִֽיו׃ס
verses.transliteration: har·‘î·p̄ū šā·ma·yim mim·ma·‘al ū·šə·ḥā·qîm yiz·zə·lū- ṣe·ḏeq ’e·reṣ tip̄·taḥ- ye·ša‘ wə·yip̄·rū- ū·ṣə·ḏā·qāh ṯaṣ·mî·aḥ ya·ḥaḏ ’ă·nî Yah·weh bə·rā·ṯîw
verses.literal: Drip down O heavens from above and let the skies pour down righteousness Let the earth open up that salvation may sprout and righteousness spring up with it I the LORD have created it

verses.original: ה֗וֹי רָ֚ב אֶת־ יֹ֣צְר֔וֹ חֶ֖רֶשׂ אֶת־ חַרְשֵׂ֣י אֲדָמָ֑ה חֹ֤מֶר הֲיֹאמַ֨ר לְיֹֽצְרוֹ֙ מַֽה־ תַּעֲשֶׂ֔ה וּפָעָלְךָ֖ אֵין־ יָדַ֥יִם לֽוֹ׃ס
verses.transliteration: hō·w rāḇ ’eṯ- yō·ṣə·rōw ḥe·reś ’eṯ- ḥar·śê ’ă·ḏā·māh ḥō·mer hă·yō·mar lə·yō·ṣə·rōw mah- ta·‘ă·śeh ū·p̄ā·‘ā·lə·ḵā ’ên- yā·ḏa·yim lōw
verses.literal: Woe to him who quarrels - with his Maker one clay pot . . . among many . . . Does the clay ask the potter What are you making Does your work say He has no hands

verses.original: ה֛וֹי אֹמֵ֥ר לְאָ֖ב מַה־ תּוֹלִ֑יד וּלְאִשָּׁ֖ה מַה־ תְּחִילִֽין׃ס
verses.transliteration: hō·w ’ō·mêr lə·’āḇ mah- tō·w·lîḏ ū·lə·’iš·šāh mah- tə·ḥî·lîn
verses.literal: Woe to him who says to his father What have you begotten or to his mother What have you brought forth

verses.original: כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֧ר יְהוָ֛ה קְד֥וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וְיֹצְר֑וֹ הָאֹתִיּ֣וֹת שְׁאָל֔וּנִי עַל־ בָּנַ֛י תְּצַוֻּֽנִי׃ וְעַל־ פֹּ֥עַל יָדַ֖י
verses.transliteration: kōh- ’ā·mar Yah·weh qə·ḏō·wōš yiś·rā·’êl wə·yō·ṣə·rōw hā·’ō·ṯî·yō·wṯ šə·’ā·lū·nî ‘al- bā·nay tə·ṣaw·wu·nî wə·‘al- pō·‘al yā·ḏay
verses.literal: Thus says the LORD the Holy One of Israel and its Maker Concerning things to come do you question Me about My sons or instruct Me in the work of My hands

verses.original: אָֽנֹכִי֙ עָשִׂ֣יתִי אֶ֔רֶץ בָרָ֑אתִי אֲנִ֗י וְאָדָ֖ם עָלֶ֣יהָ יָדַי֙ נָט֣וּ שָׁמַ֔יִם צִוֵּֽיתִי׃ וְכָל־ צְבָאָ֖ם
verses.transliteration: ’ā·nō·ḵî ‘ā·śî·ṯî ’e·reṣ ḇā·rā·ṯî ’ă·nî wə·’ā·ḏām ‘ā·le·hā yā·ḏay nā·ṭū šā·ma·yim ṣiw·wê·ṯî wə·ḵāl ṣə·ḇā·’ām
verses.literal: It is I who made the earth and created . . . man upon it It was My hands that stretched out the heavens and I ordained all their host

verses.original: אָנֹכִי֙ הַעִירֹתִ֣הֽוּ בְצֶ֔דֶק אֲיַשֵּׁ֑ר וְכָל־ דְּרָכָ֖יו הֽוּא־ יִבְנֶ֤ה עִירִי֙ וְגָלוּתִ֣י יְשַׁלֵּ֔חַ לֹ֤א בִמְחִיר֙ וְלֹ֣א בְשֹׁ֔חַד אָמַ֖ר יְהוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃פ
verses.transliteration: ’ā·nō·ḵî ha·‘î·rō·ṯi·hū ḇə·ṣe·ḏeq ’ă·yaš·šêr wə·ḵāl də·rā·ḵāw hū- yiḇ·neh ‘î·rî wə·ḡā·lū·ṯî yə·šal·lê·aḥ lō ḇim·ḥîr wə·lō ḇə·šō·ḥaḏ ’ā·mar Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ
verses.literal: I will raise up [Cyrus] in righteousness and I will make all his ways [straight] He will rebuild My city and set My exiles free but not for payment [or] reward says the LORD of Hosts

verses.original: כֹּ֣ה׀ יְהוָ֗ה אָמַ֣ר יְגִ֨יעַ מִצְרַ֥יִם וּֽסְחַר־ כּוּשׁ֮ וּסְבָאִים֮ אַנְשֵׁ֣י מִדָּה֒ יַעֲבֹ֙רוּ֙ עָלַ֤יִךְ יִֽהְי֔וּ וְלָ֣ךְ אַחֲרַ֣יִךְ יֵלֵ֔כוּ יַעֲבֹ֑רוּ בַּזִּקִּ֖ים יִֽשְׁתַּחֲוּוּ֙ וְאֵלַ֤יִךְ יִתְפַּלָּ֔לוּ אֵלַ֣יִךְ אֵ֛ל אַ֣ךְ בָּ֥ךְ וְאֵ֥ין ע֖וֹד אֶ֥פֶס אֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: kōh Yah·weh ’ā·mar yə·ḡî·a‘ miṣ·ra·yim ū·sə·ḥar- kūš ū·sə·ḇā·’îm ’an·šê mid·dāh ya·‘ă·ḇō·rū ‘ā·la·yiḵ yih·yū wə·lāḵ ’a·ḥă·ra·yiḵ yê·lê·ḵū ya·‘ă·ḇō·rū baz·ziq·qîm yiš·ta·ḥăw·wū wə·’ê·la·yiḵ yiṯ·pal·lā·lū ’ê·la·yiḵ ’êl ’aḵ bāḵ wə·’ên ‘ō·wḏ ’e·p̄es ’ĕ·lō·hîm
verses.literal: This is what the LORD says The products of Egypt and the merchandise of Cush along with the Sabeans men of stature will come over to you and will be yours they will trudge behind you they will come over in chains and bow down to you They will confess to you God is indeed with you and there is no other there is no other God

verses.original: אָכֵ֕ן אַתָּ֖ה אֵ֣ל מִסְתַּתֵּ֑ר אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מוֹשִֽׁיעַ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·ḵên ’at·tāh ’êl mis·tat·têr ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl mō·wō·šî·a‘
verses.literal: Truly You are a God who hides Himself O God of Israel the Savior

verses.original: כֻּלָּ֑ם בּ֥וֹשׁוּ וְגַֽם־ נִכְלְמ֖וּ חָרָשֵׁ֖י צִירִֽים׃ הָלְכ֣וּ יַחְדָּו֙ בַכְּלִמָּ֔ה
verses.transliteration: kul·lām bō·wō·šū wə·ḡam- niḵ·lə·mū ḥā·rā·šê ṣî·rîm hā·lə·ḵū yaḥ·dāw ḇak·kə·lim·māh
verses.literal: They will all be put to shame and humiliated the makers of idols will depart together in disgrace

verses.original: יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ נוֹשַׁ֣ע בַּיהוָ֔ה עוֹלָמִ֑ים תְּשׁוּעַ֖ת לֹא־ תֵבֹ֥שׁוּ וְלֹא־ תִכָּלְמ֖וּ עַד־ ע֥וֹלְמֵי עַֽד׃פ
verses.transliteration: yiś·rā·’êl nō·wō·ša‘ Yah·weh ‘ō·w·lā·mîm tə·šū·‘aṯ lō- ṯê·ḇō·šū wə·lō- ṯik·kā·lə·mū ‘aḏ- ‘ō·wl·mê ‘aḏ
verses.literal: [But] Israel will be saved by the LORD with an everlasting salvation you will not be put to shame . . . or humiliated to ages everlasting

verses.original: כִּ֣י כֹ֣ה אָֽמַר־ יְ֠הוָה בּוֹרֵ֨א הַשָּׁמַ֜יִם ה֣וּא הָאֱלֹהִ֗ים יֹצֵ֨ר הָאָ֤רֶץ וְעֹשָׂהּ֙ ה֣וּא כֽוֹנְנָ֔הּ לֹא־ בְרָאָ֖הּ תֹ֥הוּ יְצָרָ֑הּ לָשֶׁ֣בֶת אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה וְאֵ֥ין עֽוֹד׃
verses.transliteration: kî ḵōh ’ā·mar- Yah·weh bō·w·rê haš·šā·ma·yim hū hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm yō·ṣêr hā·’ā·reṣ wə·‘ō·śāh hū ḵō·wn·nāh lō- ḇə·rā·’āh ṯō·hū yə·ṣā·rāh lā·še·ḇeṯ ’ă·nî Yah·weh wə·’ên ‘ō·wḏ
verses.literal: For thus says the LORD who created the heavens He [is] God He formed the earth and fashioned it He established it He did not create it to be empty but formed it to be inhabited I am the LORD and there is no other

verses.original: לֹ֧א דִּבַּ֗רְתִּי בַסֵּ֣תֶר בִּמְקוֹם֙ אֶ֣רֶץ חֹ֔שֶׁךְ לֹ֥א אָמַ֛רְתִּי לְזֶ֥רַע יַעֲקֹ֖ב בַקְּשׁ֑וּנִי תֹּ֣הוּ אֲנִ֤י יְהוָה֙ דֹּבֵ֣ר צֶ֔דֶק מַגִּ֖יד מֵישָׁרִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: lō dib·bar·tî ḇas·sê·ṯer bim·qō·wm ’e·reṣ ḥō·šeḵ lō ’ā·mar·tî lə·ze·ra‘ ya·‘ă·qōḇ ḇaq·qə·šū·nî tō·hū ’ă·nî Yah·weh dō·ḇêr ṣe·ḏeq mag·gîḏ mê·šā·rîm
verses.literal: I have not spoken in secret from a place in a land of darkness I did not say to the descendants of Jacob Seek Me in a wasteland I the LORD speak the truth I say what is right

verses.original: וָבֹ֛אוּ הִקָּבְצ֥וּ הִֽתְנַגְּשׁ֥וּ יַחְדָּ֖ו פְּלִיטֵ֣י הַגּוֹיִ֑ם לֹ֣א יָדְע֗וּ הַנֹּֽשְׂאִים֙ אֶת־ פִּסְלָ֔ם עֵ֣ץ וּמִתְפַּלְלִ֔ים אֶל־ אֵ֖ל לֹ֥א יוֹשִֽׁיעַ׃
verses.transliteration: wā·ḇō·’ū hiq·qā·ḇə·ṣū hiṯ·nag·gə·šū yaḥ·dāw pə·lî·ṭê hag·gō·w·yim lō yā·ḏə·‘ū han·nō·śə·’îm ’eṯ- pis·lām ‘êṣ ū·miṯ·pal·lîm ’el- ’êl lō yō·wō·šî·a‘
verses.literal: Come gather together and draw near . . . you fugitives from the nations vvv Ignorant [are] those who carry - idols of wood and pray to a god that cannot save

verses.original: הַגִּ֣ידוּ וְהַגִּ֔ישׁוּ אַ֥ף יִֽוָּעֲצ֖וּ יַחְדָּ֑ו מִ֣י הִשְׁמִיעַ֩ זֹ֨את מִקֶּ֜דֶם הִגִּידָ֗הּ מֵאָ֣ז הֲל֨וֹא אֲנִ֤י יְהוָה֙ וְאֵֽין־ ע֤וֹד אֱלֹהִים֙ מִבַּלְעָדַ֔י צַדִּ֣יק אֵֽל־ וּמוֹשִׁ֔יעַ אַ֖יִן זוּלָתִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: hag·gî·ḏū wə·hag·gî·šū ’ap̄ yiw·wā·‘ă·ṣū yaḥ·dāw mî hiš·mî·a‘ zōṯ miq·qe·ḏem hig·gî·ḏāh mê·’āz hă·lō·w ’ă·nî Yah·weh wə·’ên- ‘ō·wḏ ’ĕ·lō·hîm mib·bal·‘ā·ḏay ṣad·dîq ’êl- ū·mō·wō·šî·a‘ ’a·yin zū·lā·ṯî
verses.literal: Speak up and present your case yes let them take counsel together Who foretold this long ago Who announced it from ancient times Was it not I the LORD There is no other God but Me a righteous God and Savior there is none but Me

verses.original: פְּנוּ־ אֵלַ֥י וְהִוָּשְׁע֖וּ כָּל־ אַפְסֵי־ אָ֑רֶץ כִּ֥י אֲנִי־ אֵ֖ל וְאֵ֥ין עֽוֹד׃
verses.transliteration: pə·nū- ’ê·lay wə·hiw·wā·šə·‘ū kāl- ’ap̄·sê- ’ā·reṣ kî ’ă·nî- ’êl wə·’ên ‘ō·wḏ
verses.literal: Turn to Me and be saved all the ends of the earth for I [am] God and there is no other

verses.original: בִּ֣י נִשְׁבַּ֔עְתִּי צְדָקָ֛ה יָצָ֨א מִפִּ֧י דָּבָ֖ר וְלֹ֣א יָשׁ֑וּב כִּי־ כָּל־ בֶּ֔רֶךְ תִּכְרַ֣ע לִי֙ כָּל־ לָשֽׁוֹן׃ תִּשָּׁבַ֖ע
verses.transliteration: bî niš·ba‘·tî ṣə·ḏā·qāh yā·ṣā mip·pî dā·ḇār wə·lō yā·šūḇ kî- kāl- be·reḵ tiḵ·ra‘ lî kāl- lā·šō·wn tiš·šā·ḇa‘
verses.literal: By Myself I have sworn truth has gone out from My mouth a word that will not be revoked . . . Every knee will bow before Me every tongue will swear [allegiance]

verses.original: אַ֧ךְ אָמַ֖ר בַּיהוָ֛ה לִ֥י צְדָק֣וֹת וָעֹ֑ז כֹּ֖ל הַנֶּחֱרִ֥ים בּֽוֹ׃ יָב֣וֹא עָדָיו֙ וְיֵבֹ֔שׁוּ
verses.transliteration: ’aḵ ’ā·mar Yah·weh lî ṣə·ḏā·qō·wṯ wā·‘ōz kōl han·ne·ḥĕ·rîm bōw yā·ḇō·w ‘ā·ḏāw wə·yê·ḇō·šū
verses.literal: Surely they will say of Me In the LORD alone [are] righteousness and strength All who rage against Him will come to Him and be put to shame

verses.original: בַּיהוָ֛ה כָּל־ זֶ֥רַע יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ יִצְדְּק֥וּ וְיִֽתְהַלְל֖וּ
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh kāl- ze·ra‘ yiś·rā·’êl yiṣ·də·qū wə·yiṯ·hal·lū
verses.literal: In the LORD all descendants of Israel will be justified and will exult
